description: A tuple constructor key in a static map can't be analyzed as a static list
notes: The spec returns each key as an expression without further interpretation, so a key written as a tuple constructor can be analyzed as a static list. hashicorp/hcl wraps every key in an ObjectConsKeyExpr (hclsyntax/expression.go), whose only static analysis method is AsTraversal. Its UnwrapExpression method returns hclsyntax.Expression instead of hcl.Expression, so it doesn't satisfy the interface that hcl.UnwrapExpressionUntil looks for, and hcl.ExprList can't reach the key's expression.
reference_error: A static list expression is required
